QF.id: XXVA Regulatory Compliance for Non-Core Research Personnel_8

question.text: Under SEBI regulations, which of the following is TRUE about record maintenance by research entities?

answer.text: Records can be destroyed after 1 year to save storage space

Research entities must maintain signed and dated research reports, recommendations and rationale, public appearance records, KYC and client register, communications with clients and prospects, and terms and conditions with client consent, preserved for at least five years
Only final published research reports need to be maintained, not drafts
Record maintenance is optional for research entities with fewer than 10 employees

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 25 requires research entities to maintain signed and dated research reports, recommendations and rationale, public appearance records, KYC and client register, communications with clients and prospects, and terms and conditions plus client consent, preserved for at least five years. The Trap: One-year retention is too short, and there is no size-based exemption from record maintenance. Note: Draft retention and a general "internal approvals" record category were not found in the checked pages and are intentionally not asserted here.
